ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (24) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The Gospel passage is translated from Tolstoy's Russian with «сын божий» (syn bozhy, 'son of God') and «отец» (otets, 'father') lowercase as in the source; it is John 5:24–26, though the source prints «Ин. гл. 5, ст. 21—26» and the printed reference is kept. «Ши-Кинг» (Shi-King) is given as the Shijing and «Передовая мысль мира» (Peredovaya mysl' mira) as The World's Advance Thought, the periodical's English title; «телесный» (telesny, 'bodily') and «плотский» (plotsky, 'fleshly') are kept distinct.

Source observation: [5] The reference «Ин. гл. 5, ст. 21—26» covers verses 21–26, but the quoted text is only John 5:24–26 (verses 21–23 are not quoted). Kept as printed ('John 5:21–26.') because the printed range contains the passage; an editor may prefer to narrow it to 5:24–26.
